baselineExternalJunctions.geometryEvidence: app/data/rail-sections.json + rail-history.json: identical existing 5-decimal vertex on both identities; 603.271 m along track to station display point (station segment endpoint plus within-station distance). Identity-agnostic shortest path 宮村 → 天橋立 (4539.254 m) passes the vertex with an incoming from-identity edge and outgoing to-identity edge. Geometry details: geometry.json.
baselineExternalJunctions.temporalEvidence: Opening of 宮福線, not the 2015-04-01 WILLER operator start. On the KTR history page, under the heading 宮福線の経緯・沿革, the 1988 row is 1月27日 レール締結式 and 7月16日 開業. The same page defines 宮福線 as 福知山–宮津, and records service at 宮津 from 1924-04-12 (峰山線 舞鶴・宮津) with the name 宮津線 from 1932-08-10. Successor chain on that page: 宮福鉄道 opened the line, renamed 北近畿タンゴ鉄道 on 1989-08-01, and WILLER TRAINS is the second-category operator. This dates the 宮津 connection of those two lines, not every current surveyed vertex.

baselineExternalJunctions.geometryEvidence: OSM way 734217342 service=crossover (OSM operator tag 京都丹後鉄道; N02 operator WILLER　TRAINS) in cache cell E135N35 (fetchedAt 2026-08-18T10:31:02.971Z). Path vertices are the cache geometry. path 62.73 m. West/east end distances to 山陰線/宮福線 vertices: 27.22/40.2 m and 34.7/43.76 m. both ends are closer to the same identity; chose the cross-identity pairing with the smaller stub sum. Attach 27.22 m and 43.76 m to those existing rail-sections.json vertices. Haversine R=6371000. Total 133.72 m.
baselineExternalJunctions.temporalEvidence: Opening of 宮福線, the later line at 福知山. KTR 沿革 (saved HTML, sha256 ca61db5337fe33caa5ca6e6eaff2c0706864522f417de18853528a6fa8a761fb), section 「宮福線の経緯・沿革」, has the route row 「宮福線」 「福知山～宮津」 and, after the 1982 宮福鉄道 licence rows, 「1988年（昭和63年）」「7月16日」「開業」. 山陰本線 was already at 福知山; this is the 宮福線 opening, not a later electrification. Inherited: opened by 宮福鉄道, now 北近畿タンゴ鉄道. This dates the 福知山 connection, not every surveyed vertex.
